summary: Sharp Top fire lookout at the Peaks of Otter, Bedford County, VA: a 1938 photo shows a wooden watchtower above a stone shelter; the lookout has been removed, and a hiking guide mentions a stone shelter on the summit.

notes_for_editor: No build date, builder, or staffing found for the Sharp Top lookout. The only dated evidence is the October 29, 1938 Blue Ridge Parkway photograph. The present stone shelter rests on a hiking guide, not an official source, so its current condition is unconfirmed. A Facebook post dates the shelter to about 1925; it was not used because it is a social-media claim we did not verify. The Forest Lookouts page gives only county, agency and Removed. Used 1 WebSearch call for the Sharp Top history and a few page reads (Forest Lookouts, NPS, Blue Ridge Parkway photo record, Willhite Web, Go Hike Virginia).
